title: Service intervals
text: The recommended service interval is every 10,000 kilometres or every 12 months, whichever comes first.

title: Warranty
text: The standard vehicle warranty lasts 3 years or 100,000 kilometres, whichever comes first.

title: Roadside assistance
text: Roadside assistance is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, while the vehicle is under warranty.

title: Booking a service
text: A service can be booked online through the customer portal or by calling the service centre.

title: Oil changes
text: Engine oil and the oil filter should be replaced at every scheduled maintenance service.

title: Brake inspection
text: Brake pads, brake discs, and brake fluid are inspected during the annual safety check.

title: Tyre pressure
text: The recommended tyre pressure is listed on the label inside the driver's door frame.

title: Cancellation policy
text: Service appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 24 hours before the booking.

title: Loan vehicles
text: A loan vehicle may be available with advance notice, subject to local branch availability.

title: Payment methods
text: The service centre accepts major credit cards, debit cards, and approved fleet accounts.
